about_the_game:
Ever stuck on foreign text while gaming or browsing the web? Language barriers are now a thing of the past!

Quick Translate Engine is a simple, fast, and powerful tool that translates any text on your screen to any language you want with a single keystroke.

FEATURES

* **Instant Translation:** Just select the text, press your custom hotkey, and the translation is ready! Write in English, and have it converted to any language with one touch; instantly translate a foreign text back to English.

* **Translate with Screenshot (OCR):** Game menus, images, or uncopiable text... No problem. Simply select an area of your screen, and the program will recognize the text and translate it for you.

* **Personal Hotkeys:** Customize the application completely by assigning your own keyboard shortcuts for all your translation needs.

* **Lightweight & Fast:** It doesn't drain your system resources and will absolutely not affect your gaming performance. It runs silently in the background and only appears when you need it.

* **Modern Interface:** An easy-on-the-eyes, simple-to-understand settings menu with Light & Dark theme options.

HOW IT WORKS

1. Set up your desired languages and hotkeys once in the settings.

2. Press your hotkey in any application.

3. That's it! Your translation is ready.

Note: This application requires an active internet connection for translation features.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 1.0 GHz Processor or better
  • Memory: 512 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Any graphics card with DirectX 10 support or better
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 900 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: An active internet connection is required for translation features.

Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: Instantly translate foreign text in any game or app! A lightweight and fast translation tool that converts any text or image on your screen to your desired language with a single hotkey. Break down language barriers.
